# Chat

> Private AI chat that answers from your own documents, with streaming replies and inline citations.

## Overview
Chat is a full-stack, production-grade AI assistant. Users upload PDF and text files to a conversation and ask questions grounded exclusively in those documents. The model can search documents via RAG, check live weather, and file human-in-the-loop bug reports to Jira.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion
- Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.14), LangGraph, SQLAlchemy (async)
- Retrieval: Mistral Embed, Pinecone vector store, Cohere reranking
- Models: Mistral ministral-14b (fallback to 8b)
- Database & Memory: PostgreSQL (UUIDv7), Redis Cloud
